headline_seed: Snapchat brings AI-powered conversational advertising to its app
description_seed: Users will be able to chat with a brand's AI agent to do things like ask questions and get recommendations.

what: Snapchat brings AI-powered conversational advertising to its app

clean_source_blocks.text: Snapchat announced on Tuesday that it’s rolling out “AI Sponsored Snaps,” which will allow users to interact directly with brands’ AI agents. Sponsored Snaps are the ads placed directly into the app’s main Chat tab. Until now, users couldn’t interact with these ads, but with the launch of AI Sponsored Ads, they’ll be able to do things like ask questions and get recommendations.
Users will be able to chat with a brand's AI agent to do things like ask questions and get recommendations.

Thrad will be actively involved in the group to provide technical insights and answer questions regarding the integration of advertising into conversational flows. Developers and brands interested in exploring the platform’s capabilities can find more information at Thrad.

"We are thrilled to support the Adtech AI Chat community during this pivotal shift toward conversational interfaces," says Andrea F. Tortella, CEO of Thrad. "Our goal is to lead the discussion on how AI advertising and agentic commerce will redefine the digital economy. We look forward to organising events and working closely with group members to build a more robust, ad-supported AI future."
